messages:
maria: FYI — drafting an RFC for phased migrations of pinned models. Need to lock launch criteria for Q2. Main constraints: Acme asked to keep `m-adapt-v2` pinned until Sept, infra capacity is tight. Please review proposal and flag blockers.

maria: High-level proposal: 1) 30d canary at 5% traffic 2) Success metrics: quality drop <= 1% on targeted eval, latency delta <= 10ms 3) Auto-rollback triggers: P99 +20% latency or quality drop >2% 4) Enterprise exceptions allowed by CS/PM agreement. Config sketch below.

maria: ```
pin_policy:
  mode: phased_migration
  canary_days: 30
  canary_traffic: 0.05
  metrics:
    quality_drop_pct: 1.0
    latency_ms_delta_p50: 10
    latency_p99_pct: 20
  rollback_on:
    - p99_latency_increase_pct > 20
    - quality_drop_pct > 2.0
  enterprise_exemption: true
```

kevin: We can build the routing and FF toggles, but we need tracing hooks + metric tags for the canary. KV cache warmup across model variants will increase mem pressure; might need a staging pool. ETA: ~2w for infra work if prioritized.

sam: Need an eval slice focused on Acme flows (billing + retrieval prompts). I can produce a 1k-case targeted eval in ~3 business days. Also recommend manual spot-checks for the top 50 failing prompts after canary.

leila: CS update: Acme PM is OK with staged migration if they can opt-out and receive 2w notice. They also want a rollback communication playbook and a single point of contact.

alex: Clarify policy for pin expiration: if customers request extensions, is that handled as support/contract work? We should make renewal process explicit in the policy.

maria: Draft policy line: "Default pins expire after 6 months. Renewals are processed via CS; extensions >6 months require a support/enterprise agreement." Thoughts?

kevin: +1 to the renewal flow. Also add observability success criteria: distributed traces instrumented, token-level cost delta < 5%, and per-route error rate <= 0.5% during canary.

sam: For launch criteria I propose: 1) Eval pass (no more than 1% quality regression) 2) Canary live for 7d with no rollback triggers 3) Manual spot-check green 4) Infra rollout smoke tests pass

maria: OK — I'll fold these into the RFC. Action items: kevin -> infra (2w), sam -> eval (3d), leila -> customer comms and opt-out flow, alex -> policy wording for renewals. I'll be owner of the RFC doc and will drop into product board for decision next Tue.

kevin: One more infra note: we should consider a short warmup window (24-48h) where new model variants receive low traffic to populate KV caches before hitting canary thresholds. Adds complexity but reduces cold-start regressions.

leila: I'll confirm Acme's opt-out SLA and ask for approval to do a joint runbook review with them.

maria: Can folks react with :thumbsup: if they agree with the plan or call out must-haves here. Planning a brief sync Wed 11am to sign off.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll push evals to the shared drive and tag the RFC.

kevin: :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup: adding to roadmap board now.
